backstory.summary: Two close friends, Alex (User A) and Jamie (User B), are meeting at The Java House coffee shop to plan a surprise birthday party for their mutual friend, Sam. They must keep the planning secret from Sam and coordinate time, location, guest list, supplies, and tasks. Throughout their conversation, they use ambiguous spatial, temporal, person, and object references due to the informal setting and the need for discretion. Their assistants only record their own voice, leading to gaps in contextual entities (e.g., when Jamie says 'the balloons,' Alex's assistant can't capture what 'the balloons' refers to). The conversation is dense with actionable references and requires protocol queries to resolve critical information for training purposes.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Hey! I just got *here*. Traffic was wild.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Glad you made it. I grabbed us a table in the back, by that big window.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Perfect. This place is packed today. Did you order yet?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: No, I was waiting for you. Let's get the usual, then we can start planning for *him*.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Right, Sam will never expect it. I’ll get coffee for both of us, be right back.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Thanks! I’ll pull up that list I made last night, you know, the one with all the tasks.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Okay, I’m back. Show me *that list*.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Here. So, first thing: Venue. Did you check if *that place* on 4th Street is available?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Yeah, I called *them* yesterday. They're open for us next Saturday.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Awesome! Next, what about the time? Should we do *it* in the afternoon or evening?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: I think afternoon works better — Sam has that thing at night, remember?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Right. So, *2pm* next Saturday at the downtown loft.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Yes. What about guests? Did you reach out to *her*?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: You mean Casey? I texted last night — she’s in! Also, Tom and Maya said they’re coming.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Perfect. Did you talk to *the coordinator* about decorations?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Not yet. Should I email *him* or do you want to?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Could you handle that? I need to finish *that document* for work later today.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Sure. I’ll email him after we’re done here.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Speaking of decorations, do we have *the balloons* or should I order more?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: I have some from last year, but they're blue. Should we get new ones instead?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Probably — Sam loves green. I'll check *that party supply store* on Main.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Great. Let me know if you need help picking *them* out.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Thanks! Food plan — do you want to do *pizza* like last time or try catering?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Let's do catering. I spoke to *that Italian place* near Sam's apartment — they're available.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Sweet! How many people should I tell them to expect?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: So far, we’ve got Tom, Maya, Casey, us, and probably three more. Seven to ten, depending if *he* brings friends.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: I’ll confirm with *Sam’s roommate* tomorrow morning.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Sam’s roommate is a wildcard. Should we ask *her* directly or just guess?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Better to ask. I’ll message *her* after we leave here.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Cool. What about music? Does anyone have *that speaker* from last time?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: I left *it* at Tom’s place, but I’ll pick it up Friday.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Nice. Make sure it’s charged!

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Will do. Gifts — are we all pitching in for *that smartwatch* Sam wanted?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Yeah. Casey said she’ll grab *it* and we can pay her back.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Awesome. Did anyone ask Sam what *he* wants for dessert?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: No, but Maya’s supposed to find out. I’ll remind *her*.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Good idea. Timing — should we meet *here* again next week to finalize?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Sure. Same time?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Let’s do Tuesday at 4pm, unless something comes up.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Works for me. By the way, did you see *that text* from Sam this morning?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: No, I was rushing. What’d he say?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: He asked if we're up to something. We need to be careful — Sam’s suspicious.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Haha, we’ll be stealthy. I’ll make sure not to leave *that flyer* out at the loft.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Good call. Let’s keep everything off social media, just in case.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Agreed. Did you give *him* the invitation for his birthday dinner, or are we waiting?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Not yet, we should wait till Friday — less time for him to snoop.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Right. I'll print *it* tomorrow morning.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Thanks. I’ll handle the RSVP list when people text *me*.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Do we need to reserve *parking* at the loft?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Good point. I’ll call them about parking passes later today.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: You’re on top of *everything*. By the way, what’s the weather supposed to be next Saturday?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Sunny! Let’s hope it stays that way.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: If it rains, we’ll move everything *inside*, right?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Yep, the loft has plenty of space.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Okay, I think we covered a lot. Can you email me *that list* so I don’t forget anything?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Absolutely, sending it now.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Thanks. Did you get a text from *Maya*? She was waiting for an update.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: I just did — she’s good for next Saturday.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Perfect. Anything else we missed?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Not unless you want to add karaoke to the agenda!

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Haha, I think Sam would love that. Let's keep it a surprise for *him*.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Agreed. Should we coordinate rides for *everyone*?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Yes, I’ll make a group chat after this.

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: Sounds great. Ready to head out?

conversation_transcript.speaker: User A
conversation_transcript.text: Yep, let’s go. See you *here* Tuesday!

conversation_transcript.speaker: User B
conversation_transcript.text: See you then!
